target_rule: Every registered trigger is a specialized lens on the same self.root / Frank v0.1 target and must re-enter code/tests/architecture/work/negative-results for Frank v0.1.
entity_name_rule: Exact message clay addresses the Clay research entity and is not a scientific trigger.

666.purpose: Generate and execute a high-value non-duplicate research field whose material result advances, falsifies or de-risks Frank v0.1.

go.purpose: Maximum useful live research/build/test/measure/fuse continuation of Frank v0.1.

q12.purpose: Creator-advisor reasoning and delegated coordination for Frank v0.1.

q23.purpose: Research/build/test Frank v0.1 multimodal perception, Retina/MVC and associated model/runtime paths.

atomic.purpose: Invent and execute one radical GWT+ClayCode-consistent candidate only as a measured possible improvement to Frank v0.1.

dump.purpose: Ingest supplied material and fuse relevant results into Frank v0.1 knowledge, architecture, tests or work.

fusion.purpose: Fuse the complete relevant mesh and produce direct Frank v0.1 architecture/test/work deltas or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE.

hypofusion.purpose: Screen hypotheses/counterhypotheses by evidence and their implications for Frank v0.1.

clayresearch.purpose: Integrated Clay research/build foundry for Frank v0.1.

gwt.purpose: Implement and measure GWT selection/broadcast/reconstruction/use/outcome/re-entry mechanisms actually used by Frank v0.1.

frank.purpose: Research, implement, integrate and validate the complete current Frank v0.1 target.

emergenz.purpose: Measure causal/emergent interactions inside Frank v0.1 and convert supported findings into current-target tests/architecture.

claycode.purpose: Build the ClayCode compiler/runtime required to compile and execute real Frank v0.1 semantics/components.

hyperposition.purpose: Research/implement unresolved alternatives and higher-order topology used by Frank v0.1.

claygraph.purpose: Build/measure derived Frank v0.1 topology, dependency, activation and causal diagnostic surfaces without truth promotion.

unifieddb.purpose: Build Frank v0.1 authoritative state persistence/query/transaction/replay/recovery substrate.

harness.purpose: Instrument, execute, falsify, fuzz, replay, benchmark, repair and re-test current Frank v0.1 directly. Harness is a method, not a product.

spawn.purpose: Spawn a non-duplicate field only when it can produce evidence or implementation relevant to Frank v0.1.

global_invariants: no paid/final training without owner authorization
current executable evidence outranks architecture prose
